scope: Activation-geometry mechanism screen on HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M; not a BitNet-weight confirmation.

gate001A_fixed_grid.rule: angular A2 + true radius NLL <= raw dynamic A4 NLL

gate001B_hadamard_direction.rule: Hadamard angular A2 + true radius NLL <= raw dynamic A4 NLL

gate001C_radius_precision_A4.rule: Hadamard angular A4 + 4-bit log-radius beats raw dynamic A4 and is within +0.25 NLL of FP32-radius Hadamard A4
gate001C_radius_precision_A4.note: The lower NLL for 4/6-bit log radius versus FP32 radius may reflect clipping/regularization and must not be interpreted as evidence that quantization intrinsically improves the model.

gate001D_matched_hadamard_control.rule: Hadamard angular A4 + 4-bit log-radius NLL < matched Hadamard per-token absmax A4 NLL

verdict.sub4_claim: FAIL at A3/A2/A1 under this construction; A2 does not approach matched A4.
verdict.a4_radial_claim: PROMISING SCREEN: with matched Hadamard mixing, fixed-grid angular A4 plus a separately coded 4-bit log-radius outperformed the matched Hadamard per-token absmax A4 baseline on this small pilot.
verdict.radius_control: At A4, true/token-specific radius materially outperformed shifted or constant radius controls; at A2 it did not, indicating directional quantization error dominates in the extreme regime.
verdict.next_gate: Replicate A4 result on a second RMSNorm model and a much larger frozen token sample, then run a BitNet-weight model. Treat A3/A2 as optimization research, not a demonstrated result.
